topic: Vision-Language-Action Flow Models for Generalist Robotics

sources.title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
sources.institution: Physical Intelligence (San Francisco, CA) with Stanford & UC Berkeley
sources.core_contribution: Flow Matching action expert coupled to PaliGemma VLM, enabling 50 Hz continuous dexterous multi-task robotic manipulation across 7 distinct embodiments.
sources.evidence_used: Model architecture topology, 50 Hz vs 3-5 Hz frequency benchmark, multi-embodiment co-training matrix

sources.title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
sources.core_contribution: Video demonstrations showing end-to-end laundry folding from dryer to table, cardboard box folding, and table bussing.
sources.evidence_used: Empirical task sequences, multi-step dexterous manipulation of deformable cloth

sources.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
sources.core_contribution: Discretized tokenized action space (256 discrete bins) operating at 3-5 Hz.
sources.evidence_used: Comparative baseline illustrating the discrete tokenization bottleneck that π0 overcomes
